name: Kasumigaoka Utaha
source:
Hobbies: Reading (Secret: Fantasizing, but she won't admit it)

Utaha is an up-and-coming young novelist. She is a student in class 3-C and wearing two hats as a student and a writer. She writes her novels under the pen name of Utako Kasumi (霞 詩子). Her first novel Koisuru Metronome (恋するメトロノーム) was published under the Fushikawa Fantastic Bunko imprint and sold over 500,000 copies. She has both intelligence and beauty, and is the brightest student in the school. Most of the students hold her in awe. She sleeps and reads a lot and usually keeps to herself but when she does open her mouth, everyone is shocked by her sharp tongue.

(Source: [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Saekano:_How_to_Raise_a_Boring_Girlfriend]Wikipedia[/url] & [url=http://www.saekano.com/character/]Saekano Offical Site[/url])
